scope.implemented: Explicit conflicting skill recovery choices: cancel, verified backup then replace, or other scope without overwrite

before.domain: Only conflict strings returned; occupying entities/trash preserved but no explicit resolution choices
before.ui: Keyboard and pointer undo ignored structured recovery outcomes
before.metadata: Permissive list skipped malformed siblings; partial undo rebuilt a manifest from known top-level fields and could discard unknown metadata

behavior.cancel: Choice defaults to cancel; preparing/declining preview does not create backups or move conflict entities. Nonconflicting items already restored by ordinary undo remain restored.
behavior.preview: Full name/scope/trash/destination/planned backup path, with wrapping and keyboard/pointer paging; n returns to choices; backup directory allocated as a path only until final y
replace: Bind journal, trash tree and occupying entity fingerprints including root identity
Create private 0700 backup batch, verified copy, 0600 backup manifest
Recheck session after backup; write pending recovery intent; recheck entities and backup
Displace occupant only after backup verified, then move deleted entity to destination
On restore failure return displaced occupant only if destination vacant; retain copies/intent on failed rollback
On success preserve verified backup and remove redundant displaced copy only after fingerprint checks
Report final journal failures as warnings with restored files retained
behavior.scope: Current other workspace/global root only, preserve original filename/disabled state; occupied path or same frontmatter name in target root refuses; original occupying entity remains intact
behavior.metadata: Strict v1 batch parser used by ordinary undo and conflict sessions; unknown fields preserved; malformed siblings, duplicate identities/entities and unknown versions refuse mutation
behavior.recoveryPending: Unfinished records refuse automatic conflict recovery; retained source/destination/backup paths survive reload and are excluded from skill retention
behavior.concurrency: Ordinary undo and conflict commit share per-batch manifest lock; stale confirmed sessions refuse. Does not claim arbitrary external-writer isolation.

domainValidation.command: pnpm build && node --test test/domain/skill-recovery.test.js test/domain/skill-move.test.js test/domain/write.test.js
cases: replace recovery verifies a private backup and preserves directory content, modes and empty dirs
replace recovery preserves a disabled flat filename and exact occupying bytes in backup
workspace to global recovery leaves original occupant intact and creates no overwrite backup
global disabled file can recover to the current workspace without overwriting either scope
preparing then cancelling a choice does not create backups or change any source or journal bytes
stale destination, trash or journal snapshots refuse commits before any backup or replacement
new target entity or same-name skill created after preview refuses alternate-scope recovery
failed backup copy or backup journal does not move the occupying entity or trash
failed recovery intent leaves both original entities intact and keeps the verified backup
destination changes after backup or intent are preserved and stop displacement
restore failure after displacement rolls occupying data back and leaves trash retryable
failed rollback preserves backup, displaced data, trash and a durable pending record
final journal cleanup failure reports restored files and retains intent and backup
symlink occupant backup keeps the link and does not modify its external target
system, same-scope, linked roots and malformed trash paths are rejected
linked backup root is refused before copying or displacing any data
two competing recovery sessions cannot both replace the same entry
replacement also verifies backup and restores correctly across real devices
backup corruption after intent is detected before displacing the occupant
single-entry recovery preserves other directory entries in the same trash batch
malformed siblings, duplicate IDs or unknown journal versions refuse recovery without rewriting data
recovering one entry preserves unknown journal and sibling metadata

uiValidation.realRuntimeHeadless: default cancel, preview decline, stale target refusal, exact occupant backup, other-scope preservation
uiValidation.mouseMethod: Actual SGR press/release reports through host hit testing; same-target independent clicks separated from host 500ms multi-click selection window

realTui.driver: Actual isolated DSH CLI in owned PTY; stdin and ANSI replay; actual filesystem hashes/modes/journal checks

limits: No arbitrary concurrent-writer transaction or fsync/power-loss guarantee
Directory chains containing symbolic links refuse automatic recovery; an entity itself may be a literal symlink
Normal modes/content/link targets, not ACL/xattr/owner/timestamp/hardlink topology preservation
Private overwrite backups persist; extra copy and hashing cost; no new automatic backup cleanup policy
Interrupted records need inspection of retained locations; no forced retry
Other conflicts require another u; successful nonconflicting restores are not rolled back by cancel
